name: FIRST EPSS
summary: Exploit Prediction Scoring System: the daily probability (and percentile) that a CVE will be exploited in the next 30 days, current or historical, from FIRST.
notes: Keyless. Public endpoints allow 1,000 requests per minute; a 429 means a temporary block.
Scores and percentiles come back as decimal strings ('0.972240000'), not numbers.
The endpoint is marked BETA by FIRST.

endpoints.name: Get EPSS scores
endpoints.summary: EPSS score and percentile per CVE, filtered by CVE IDs, score or percentile thresholds, date or recency.

cve.description: Comma-separated CVE IDs, at most 2,000 characters in all.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, from 2021-04-14: scores as of that day.

days.description: Only CVEs whose score was added within this many days (from 1).

epss-gt.description: Only CVEs with an EPSS score at or above this (0 to 1).

epss-lt.description: Only CVEs with an EPSS score at or below this.

percentile-gt.description: Only CVEs at or above this percentile (0 to 1).

percentile-lt.description: Only CVEs at or below this percentile.

q.description: Partial match on the CVE ID.

scope.description: public (default): current fields; time-series: the last 30 days of scores per CVE.

limit.description: Records to return, 0 to 10,000 (the answer shows 100 by default).

sort.description: Comma-separated fields to sort by; prefix with '-' for descending.

notes: Without a cve or threshold filter it pages through every scored CVE: use total, offset and limit in the envelope.
